# Copilot instructions

This repository is token-tithe, a token-donation engine for open source. The canonical
instructions are in `/AGENTS.md`; its hard rules (R1–R19) are non-negotiable. If
`state/HANDOVER.md` exists, read it first and resume from it, then read `brain/BRAIN.md`.

Fresh clone with no `.venv/`? Set it up by following `docs/AGENT_SETUP.md`.
